svg.title: Causal mask in a decoder-only model
svg.desc: A 6 by 6 attention mask for the groups instruction, document 1, document 2 (the answer document), document 3, question and answer. Cells above the diagonal are blocked. The document rows cannot see the question column. The question and answer rows see all documents.
svg.text: Causal mask in a decoder-only model
Each row is a group of tokens that reads. Each column is a group of tokens that is read. A token sees only earlier tokens.
Red box: documents cannot see the question
The question comes after D1, D2 and D3.
So the model builds each document vector
Gold box: the answer sees every document
The question row and the answer row
see D1, D2 and D3. So the answer can
attend to D2, the answer document,
